text:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — Chris at Northbank (UK fintech) raised vendor risk questions; they need proof of our logging/monitoring controls for their SIG/CAIQ review. Specifically asking about admin activity logging, retention length, SIEM exportability, and tamper-proofing. Need a short bundle we can share with their risk folks.

Devon (Solutions): I can put together a bundle: retention policy blurb, sanitized sample audit logs, and the SIEM connector guide. @Maria (Security) can you confirm retention/immutability details and any small wording we should use for Hosted vs Dedicated/Private?

Maria (Security): Short answers for the bundle: - Admin activity is logged for console + API actions across all deployment modes. Hosted default retention = 90 days; 1 year retention available as an enterprise add-on (configurable). Dedicated/Private: customers can control retention and we support local WORM options.
- Exports: we support push to S3, syslog, and HTTPS endpoints for SIEM ingestion (examples for Splunk/QRadar/Elastic included).
- Tamper-evidence: exported bundles include a signed manifest (SHA256) and optional timestamping via our KMS/HSM integration.
I'll attach the logging_controls doc and the SIG-CAIQ mapping link in the bundle.

Chris (Northbank): Can you also provide a redacted example event and the schema? Our risk team wants to see sample entries and the fields.

Devon (Solutions): Uploading a sanitized sample now to the repo for sharing. Also dropping the audit API snippet so you can pull logs directly for the POC:

```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?from=2025-03-01&to=2025-04-01\"
```

Devon (Solutions): Sample event fields included: timestamp, request_id, actor, actor_role, actor_source_ip, action, resource, pre_state_hash, post_state_hash, change_summary. Redacted sample uploaded to: https://drive.redwood.internal/sales/chris_northbank/98765/sample-audit-log.json

Alex (Sales): Great. @Maria (Security) — can you confirm retention add-on pricing and any notes on export bandwidth so I can include in the quote?

Maria (Security): Pricing note: 1yr retention add-on = +$0.02/GB/month; tiered discounts for committed volumes apply (e.g., >10TB). Export bandwidth billed at cost (passed-through), we include an estimate in the bundle. For Dedicated/Private we include guidance on using customer-managed storage to avoid egress charges.

DeployBot: support ticket #98765 created — artifacts uploaded to /internal/sales/chris_northbank/98765/ (owner: Devon).

Chris (Northbank): Thanks — one quick follow-up: do admin events include assume-role/impersonation and pre/post policy diffs? That's a blocker for our GRC.

Maria (Security): Yes — we log role assumption/impersonation, token issuance, and policy change events. Events include actor identity, actor_source_ip, request_id, and when applicable we attach a small pre/post policy diff (summary) or link to the full policy snapshot. That should cover GRC evidence requests.

Alex (Sales): I'll assemble the bundle (controls doc, SIG-CAIQ map, sanitized logs, pricing snippet, API snippet) and send to you today. If they want a short walkthrough call, proposing Tue 10:00 GMT. @Chris (Northbank) — does that work?

Chris (Northbank): Tue 10:00 GMT works for me. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
